name: Tenacious
description: The Tenacious was an Imperial I-class Star Destroyer in service to the Galactic Empire that was under the command of Captain Adre L'Mendi. After being notified that there was a Rebel Alliance starship above Wobani, Captain L'Mendi and the Tenacious arrived in the Wobani system and destroyed the rebel CR90 corvette Vigilant and engaged Red Flight.

data.name: Tenacious
engine: Cygnus Spaceworks Gemon-4 ion engines (4) (emergency use)
